🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). Confirmations: weak overall breadth plus major divergences among large caps (multiple 1W vs 1M mismatches) support a cautious stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials lead: FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +24.02%), NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +23.88%). Technology showing selective strength: NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +0.20%), MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.34% | 1M: +1.57%). Financials hold firm: COF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +20.53%), C ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +17.65%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy weak: VLO BELOW TREND (1W: -3.09% | 1M: -4.75%), XOM BELOW TREND (1W: -0.91% | 1M: -0.28%). Utilities weak: NEE BELOW TREND (1W: -2.58% | 1M: -5.01%), AEP BELOW TREND (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -5.30%). Consumer Staples soft: COST BELOW TREND (1W: -0.57% | 1M: -4.22%).

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: EL ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.90% | 1M: +25.16%), FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +24.02%), NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +23.88%), COF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +20.53%), GM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.45% | 1M: +20.46%). Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5) reflecting cyclical/materials/financial tilt.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: COST BELOW TREND (1W: -0.57% | 1M: -4.22%), APD BELOW TREND (1W: -2.06% | 1M: -4.43%), VLO BELOW TREND (1W: -3.09% | 1M: -4.75%), NEE BELOW TREND (1W: -2.58% | 1M: -5.01%), AEP BELOW TREND (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -5.30%). Weakness concentrated in Utilities/Energy and select staples.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strong 1W movers: EL (1W: +6.90%), BA ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.18% | 1M: +19.34%), ORCL POTENTIAL REVERSAL (1W: +3.81% | 1M: -8.89%), FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +24.02%). Market shows MAJOR divergence across big caps (AAPL, GOOGL, JPM, JNJ, UNH, etc.), so treat momentum signals as tactical not structural.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed: Tech: 11/19 positive. NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +0.20%), MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.34% | 1M: +1.57%), AAPL TREND EXHAUSTION (1W: -0.16% | 1M: +2.79%). Expect selective stock picking as leadership is concentrated.

8. Financials Outlook?
Internal rotation: Financials: 10/20 positive. COF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +20.53%), C ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +17.65%), JPM TREND EXHAUSTION (1W: -0.88% | 1M: +6.31%). Financials are a favored source of cyclical exposure but watch internals.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Soft/defensive idling: Healthcare: 5/15 positive. LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.87% | 1M: +2.70%), BMY TREND EXHAUSTION (1W: -0.18% | 1M: +17.96%), JNJ TREND EXHAUSTION (1W: -3.64% | 1M: +2.27%). Sector shows mixed leadership and short-term weakness in large names.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Materials and select Financials given ABOVE TREND performers (FCX, NEM, COF) while reducing exposure to Utilities and Energy where multiple names are BELOW TREND (NEE, VLO). Style: Value/Cyclical preference, but breadth is weak so positioning should be selective and tactical.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: EL ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.90% | 1M: +25.16%), FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +24.02%), BA ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.18% | 1M: +19.34%). BEARISH: NEE BELOW TREND (1W: -2.58% | 1M: -5.01%), VLO BELOW TREND (1W: -3.09% | 1M: -4.75%), JNJ TREND EXHAUSTION (1W: -3.64% | 1M: +2.27%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials (6/7 positive; 1W: +0.86% | 1M: +10.34%) and Financials (10/20 positive; 1W: +0.02% | 1M: +10.73%). BEARISH: Energy (2/8 positive; 1W: -3.02% | 1M: -0.26%) and Utilities (1/6 positive; 1W: -1.12% | 1M: -4.13%).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +0.20%) — failure to hold 1W gains would signal loss of momentum. Watch AAPL TREND EXHAUSTION (1W: -0.16% | 1M: +2.79%) for a 1M support break as a broader risk cue. Watch COF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +20.53%) for continuation above recent 1M highs as confirmation of financials-led rotation.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with a Value/Cyclical preference given Materials and Financials strength and weak breadth. Key names showing strength: FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +24.02%), EL ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.90% | 1M: +25.16%), COF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +20.53%). Main risk: major divergence across large caps (multiple TREND EXHAUSTION / POTENTIAL REVERSAL signals) — monitor for trend breaks before increasing cycle exposure.
